_about: Public-domain John Pierce (1773-1849), Unitarian minister of the First Church, Brookline, for fifty years, for the Word Hoard: A Valedictory Sermon on leaving the old meeting house, a centennial discourse (1817), The Right of Private Judgment in Religion, a Dorchester discourse (1830), Reminiscences of Forty Years, Brookline Jubilee, and Requisites to our Country's Glory. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 106 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jpierce-valedictory: A valedictory sermon, on leaving the old meeting house in Brookline, 8 June, 1806; and a dedicatory sermon, on entering the new house of worship, 11 June, 1806 (Cambridge [Mass.] William Hilliard, printer, 1806)
jpierce-centennial-1817: A discourse delivered, 9 November, 1817 : the Lord's day after the completion of a century from the gathering of the church in Brookline (Boston : Printed by John Eliot ..., 1818)
jpierce-private-judgment: The right of private judgment in religion, vindicated against the claims of the Romish Church and all kindred usurpations, in a Dudleian lecture, delivered before the University in Cambridge, 24 October, 1821 (Cambridge [Mass.] : Printed by Hilliard and Metcalf, 1821)
jpierce-dorchester-1830: A discourse delivered at Dorchester, on 17 June, 1830 : to commemorate the completion of the second century from its settlement by our Pilgrim fathers (Boston : From the Office of the Daily Advertiser, 1830)
jpierce-reminiscences: Reminiscences of forty years, delivered, 19 March, 1837, the Lord's day after the completion of forty years from his settlement in the ministry, in Brookline (Boston, M. Pratt, printer, 1837)
jpierce-brookline-jubilee: Brookline Jubilee : a discourse delivered in Brookline, at the request of its inhabitants, on 15 March, 1847, the day, which completed half a century from his ordination (Boston : [publisher not identified]; (Boston : Thurston, Torry and Company), 1847)
jpierce-countrys-glory: Requisites to our country's glory (Boston : Dutton and Wentworth, state printers, 1849)
